title: W9 C7 -- Embed applied fonts in Word export
description: Follow section '### C7 --' of docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/PLAN.md exactly, plus its 'Rules for every worker'. Verify: vitest src/export passes, including existing Word tests. No browser tests. No commits, no new packages, never run npm run build or a native screen script. Write the note docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/notes/C7.md.

handoff.text: Rejected on one plan-default gap that can make Word export worse than today. The rest is right: triples are collected from body, nested tables and notes and resolved once; only 'installable' and 'editable' fonts are embedded; one entry per family, preferring regular; run names are written as before; fail-first is 3/6 before and 6/6 after. FINDING 1 (blocking): the plan's stop rule 'embedding an .otf makes the library throw' was neither tested nor defaulted, and the note says a Packer throw is not caught, so one font would fail the whole .docx export. The owner is away, so apply the plan's default: embed TrueType only. Check the bytes' first four bytes are 00 01 00 00 or 'true'; skip 'OTTO' (CFF) and anything else. Also guard the pack step: if Packer.toBlob throws while fonts are set, rebuild once without the fonts option so the export still succeeds exactly as today. Add unit tests: (i) a resolved font whose bytes start with 'OTTO' is not embedded and the export succeeds; (ii) a Packer failure caused by a bad font falls back to a no-fonts export, for example a source returning installable bytes that docx cannot use, or a stubbed Packer that throws only when fonts is set. Show both fail before the guard. Record 'embedded fonts: TrueType only' in C7.md for docs/limitations.md (D1). FINDING 2 (note only): FontOptions.data is typed Buffer and Uint8Array is cast to it; this was checked only in Node. The finding-1 fallback makes a browser-side failure harmless. Say in C7.md that the WebKit build was not checked, and add it to the hand check for the final owner-present task (T278). Rerun npx vitest run src/export and npx tsc -b and report the counts.

review.note: Approved (agent-2ff3, W9 reviewer r2). Earlier rejection demands met: (1) TrueType only: isTrueType in src/export/docx.ts checks the first four bytes 00 01 00 00 or 'true'; OTTO/CFF, WOFF and anything else are skipped while run names are still written; (2) pack guard: Packer.toBlob(buildDoc(fonts)) in try, on a throw with fonts set it rebuilds once with no fonts (a throw with no fonts is rethrown, as before); (3) Uint8Array-as-Buffer still Node-only, now stated in C7.md and handed to T278 as a hand check, and the fallback makes a browser-side throw harmless. New tests really test it: the OTTO case would embed one file without isTrueType; the fallback case uses a docx stub whose Packer throws only when 'Poison Face' is in fonts, so it fails without the guard (worker's fail-first: 2 failed | 6 passed before). Fixture switch from the bundled WOFF to synthetic TTF bytes is justified (WOFF is not TrueType); old expectations unchanged. Plan steps 3-4 met (triples from body, nested tables and notes, resolved once; installable/editable only; one entry per family, regular preferred; run names untouched). Fresh runs: npx vitest run src/export -> 10 files, 175/175 passed; npx tsc -b -> exit 0. For D1: 'embedded fonts: TrueType only'. For T278: export a .docx with an added TrueType font in the built app (WebKit) and open it in Word and Pages; a silent fallback there would mean the font is simply not embedded.
